title: TEXT STARTS AT 100 PERCENT
why: His 10-31 order: text size should default to 100 percent. A new profile and both arcade demo windows start at 100 percent text with the matching menu zoom, no longer the TV size. Saves keep their own size. Watch: text starts at 100%.
now: Text size now starts at 100 percent for new players and in the demo. Settings and the minus and equals keys still change it.
